title: Safe POSIX Port Isolation & Process Termination
description: Locate process occupying a network port via lsof/ss, identify owner/binary, and perform safe progressive SIGTERM/SIGKILL termination.

procedure.name: identify
procedure.purpose: Extract the exact PID listening on the given port

procedure.name: inspect
procedure.purpose: Verify process command line and user to prevent accidental system service kills

procedure.name: terminate
procedure.purpose: Attempt graceful SIGTERM first, follow with SIGKILL if still hanging
